#Combine all univariate MR results
```{r}
# Set path to your folder
folder_path <- "/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/results/Aadrita_results/univariate_mr_results"

# List all CSV files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all CSVs
combined_df <- purrr::map_dfr(csv_files, read_csv)

# Check result
glimpse(combined_df)
```

#Clean dataframe
```{r}
combined_df_clean <- combined_df %>%
  select(-id.exposure, -id.outcome, -nsnp) %>% 
  filter(method %in% c(
    "Inverse variance weighted (fixed effects)",
    "MR Egger",
    "Weighted median",
    "Weighted mode"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(exposure = str_replace(exposure, "^mtDNA_", "")) %>% 
  mutate(outcome = str_replace(outcome, "nalls_PD", "nalls"))

# Check the result
head(combined_df_clean)

#write_csv(combined_df_clean, "/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/results/Aadrita_results/combined_univariate_results.csv")
```

# Calculate ORs 
```{r}
odds_ratios <- combined_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(b),
    OR_lci95 = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
    OR_uci95 = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
    pval = pval
  ) 

```

#Rename stuff
```{r}
odds_ratios <- odds_ratios %>% 
  mutate(
    exposure = tools::toTitleCase(exposure),
    outcome = tools::toTitleCase(outcome)) %>% 
  mutate(
    method = gsub("Inverse variance weighted \\(fixed effects\\)", "IVW", method)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = recode(outcome,
                     "Bellenguez" = "AD/dementia",
                     "Kunkle" = "AD",
                     "Nalls" = "PD")
  )
```


#Plot
```{r}
# Step 1: Prepare truncated dataset with capped CI and flag for arrows
odds_ratios_plot <- odds_ratios %>%
  mutate(
    OR_uci95_capped = ifelse(OR_uci95 > 2, 2, OR_uci95),
    is_truncated = OR_uci95 > 2
  )

# Step 2: Base plot with capped CI
or_plot <- ggplot(odds_ratios_plot, aes(
  y = method,
  x = OR,
  xmin = OR_lci95,
  xmax = OR_uci95_capped,
  color = exposure
)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~outcome) +
  labs(
    title = "Univariate MR results for mtDNAcn onto AD and PD",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Method",
    color = "Exposure"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)

# Step 3: Add arrows for truncated values
or_plot <- or_plot +
  geom_segment(
    data = odds_ratios_plot %>% filter(is_truncated),
    aes(
      x = OR_uci95_capped,
      xend = OR_uci95_capped + 0.05,  # tiny arrow segment
      y = method,
      yend = method,
      color = exposure
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

or_plot


#ggsave("/wynton/group/andrews/users/achatterjee/mtdnacn/Brian-Estimating-Causality-mtDNAcn-on-Alzheimer/results/Aadrita_results/plots/univariate_mr_results_mtdnacn_onto_ad_pd.png", or_plot, units = "in", width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```
